title: [Launched] Generally Available: Network egress controls for hosted agents in Microsoft Foundry
summary: Network egress controls for hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service are now generally available.Create rules that allow or deny destinations, or rewrite destinations. Audit mode logs deny decisions without blocking them. Rewrite rules still take effect.Hea
content: Network egress controls for hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service are now generally available. Create rules that allow or deny destinations, or rewrite destinations. Audit mode logs deny decisions without blocking them. Rewrite rules still take effect. Header transformation rules are in preview and also take effect in audit mode. Learn more.
